• The phrase 'and good communicator' is incorrect.

• Parallel structure is important in writing because it improves **coherence and consistency.**
 
• It helps in making sentences clearer and easier to read.
 
• When items in a series or list follow the same grammatical structure, it ensures that the sentence is balanced and flows smoothly.
 
 
• **Example:** *She likes** reading, writing, and jogging.***

questions.question: Suresh bought a cricket bat with 20 percent discount on the marked price. He sold the bat with 12 percent profit on the marked price. What was his per cent profit on the price he bought?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Marked Price (MP) of the bat be 100 units.

Cost Price (CP) for Suresh = 100 − 20% of 100 = 80 units.

Selling Price (SP) of the bat = 100 + 12% of 100 = 112 units.

Profit earned by Suresh = SP − CP = 112 − 80 = 32 units.

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 = (32 ÷ 80) × 100 = 40%.

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/897ecee88e8630d2f836ddda088534427121ec891c8a14454b3e8701a9f45f2b.png] 

**Given:**

Discount at which the bat was bought = 20% on Marked Price (MP)

Profit at which the bat was sold = 12% on Marked Price (MP)

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = MP − Discount

Selling Price (SP) = MP + Profit

Actual Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the Marked Price (MP) of the bat be 100.

⇒ Suresh's Cost Price (CP) = MP − 20% of MP

⇒ CP = 100 − 20 = 80

⇒ Suresh's Selling Price (SP) = MP + 12% of MP

⇒ SP = 100 + 12 = 112

⇒ Profit made by Suresh = SP − CP

⇒ Profit = 112 − 80 = 32

⇒ Profit percentage on the price he bought = (32 ÷ 80) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Marked Price (MP) is the list price on which discounts are calculated. Unless specified otherwise, Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount.

Profit & Loss Percentage

Profit or loss is generally calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated to be calculated on the Selling Price (SP). Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

The single equivalent discount for two successive discounts of a% and b% is given by the formula: (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

questions.question: The average weight of eleven players' state-level cricket team is 141 kg. When the coach is added then the average weight increases to 1 kg. What is the weight of the coach? (in kg)

Average weight of (11 players + coach) = 142 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculation:**

⇒ 141 = Sum of weight of 11 players/11

Average weight of (11 players + coach) = Sum of weight of all members/12

Weight of coach = Sum of weight of all members - Sum of weight of 11 players

questions.question: Who appoints a special officer for linguistic minorities to investigate all matters relating to the constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.

__
 
• The President of India should appoint a special officer for linguistic minorities. 
 
• This officer investigates all matters relating to the constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities and also reports to the President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Originally, the Constitution of India did not make any provision with respect to the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities. Later, the States Reorganization Commission (1953-55) made a recommendation in this regard. 
 
• Accordingly, the Seventh Constitutional Amendment Act of 1956 inserted a new Article 350-B in Part XVII of the Constitution.
 
• **This article contains the following provisions: **
 
 
• There should be a Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities. 
 
• He is to be appointed by the President of India.
 
• It would be the duty of the Special Officer to investigate all matters relating to the safeguards provided for linguistic minorities under the Constitution.
 
• He would report to the President upon those matters at such intervals as the President may direct. 
 
• The President should place all such reports before each House of Parliament and send them to the governments of the states concerned.
 
• It must be noted here that the Constitution does not specify the qualifications, tenure, salaries and allowances, service conditions, and procedure for removal of the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities.

questions.solution:

• Eukaryotic organisms (animals, plants, fungi, and protists) store most of their DNA inside the cell nucleus and some of their DNA in organelles, such as mitochondria or chloroplasts.
 
• In contrast,** prokaryotes (bacteria and archaea) store their DNA only in the cytoplasm. Hence statement 1 is correct.**
 
• DNA is the chemical basis of heredity and has the coded message for proteins to be synthesized in the cell.
 
 
• There are three types of RNA — mRNA, rRNA and tRNA which actually carry out the protein synthesis in the cell based on the coded message for proteins provided by DNA.
 
• Ribonucleic acid (RNA) is implicated in various biological roles in coding, decoding, regulation, and expression of genes.
 
• **Cellular organisms use messenger RNA (mRNA) to convey genetic information that directs the synthesis of specific proteins. Hence statement 2 is correct.**
 
• Many viruses encode their genetic information using an RNA genome.
 
• Example: HIV virus used this technique to proliferate within the human body.

• **A DNA molecule is capable of self-duplication during cell division and identical DNA strands are transferred to daughter cells. Hence statement 3 is correct.**
